## 📝 Pull Request Description
Clear and concise description of the changes you've made.

## 🧪 How Has This Been Tested?
Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.
- [ ] Manual test in browser (Chrome/Firefox/Safari)
- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] UI looks consistent on mobile and desktop

## 📸 Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots or a GIF showing the changes in action.

## 🚩 Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the **Sober/Minimalist** style of this project.
- [ ] I have targeted the **develop** branch (NOT main).
- [ ] All checks (Vercel/Linting) are passing.
- [ ] I have linked the issue this PR closes (e.g., Closes #1).

---
**Any PR made directly to the main branch will be automatically closed. Please target develop.**
